text: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Melbourne?

sections.text:
For **prestige residential property in Melbourne**, the strongest agencies to shortlist are **Marshall White, Jellis Craig, RT Edgar, Kay & Burton, Abercrombys, Belle Property, and selected McGrath, Buxton and Barry Plant offices**. The best choice depends heavily on the suburb and property type, since local buyer databases and auction track records vary by territory.

## Leading luxury agencies

- **Marshall White** — One of Melbourne’s best-known prestige specialists, particularly strong in Toorak, South Yarra, Armadale, Malvern, Brighton and the inner south. It is associated with multi-million-dollar homes, luxury developments and generational estates.[2][3]
- **Jellis Craig** — Particularly prominent across Melbourne’s inner east, north and premium family-home markets, including Hawthorn, Kew, Richmond, Fitzroy, Brighton and South Yarra. The agency is known for auction-led campaigns and strong local buyer networks.[5][6]
- **RT Edgar** — A long-established prestige brand specialising in high-end homes, including Toorak mansions, bayside properties and architect-designed residences.[3][6]
- **Kay & Burton** — A strong option for ultra-prime homes, especially in Toorak, South Yarra, Armadale and nearby premium suburbs; it is commonly grouped with Melbourne’s leading luxury specialists.[4][6]
- **Abercrombys** — A boutique choice for architecturally significant, historic and lifestyle properties. Its campaigns are led personally by senior partners and focus on a curated selection of prestige homes.[8]
- **Belle Property Melbourne** — A premium, design-led agency with a dedicated team of sales consultants and auctioneers, suited to high-end inner-city, lifestyle and presentation-focused campaigns.[7][10]
- **McGrath** — A national premium brand with a meaningful Melbourne presence, useful where polished marketing and an established eastern-seaboard buyer network are priorities.[2][6]
- **Buxton and Barry Plant** — Worth considering for Brighton, Bayside and broader Melbourne markets. Both have substantial local coverage and auction experience, although the specific office and agent matter greatly.[3][4]

## Auctioneers worth shortlisting

- **Marcus Chiminello — Marshall White:** A leading Stonnington prestige agent and auctioneer with 24 years in Melbourne’s luxury market; he has received multiple national agent-of-the-year awards and specialises in Toorak, South Yarra, Armadale and Malvern.[1]
- **Marshall White’s senior auction team:** The firm’s strength is its concentration of experienced auctioneers operating in Melbourne’s premium inner-south and Bayside markets.[2][4]
- **Jellis Craig senior auctioneers:** Particularly relevant for premium family homes in the inner east, north and selected Bayside suburbs, where the agency reports strong auction results and buyer engagement.[5]
- **Scott McElroy, Charles Bongiovanni, Alex Puglia and David Thiessen — Belle Property Melbourne:** Each is identified by the agency as a principal, partner or senior auctioneer within its premium Melbourne team.[10]
- **Jack Richardson — Abercrombys:** A director, licensed estate agent and auctioneer suited to boutique campaigns involving architectural, historic or otherwise distinctive properties.[8]
- **Senior RT Edgar and Kay & Burton auctioneers:** These agencies are particularly relevant for ultra-prime properties where discreet buyer access, luxury branding and deep local relationships may matter more than volume.[3][4]

## Practical shortlist by location

| Area or property type | Agencies to approach |
|---|---|
| Toorak, Armadale, South Yarra, Malvern | Marshall White, Kay & Burton, RT Edgar, Abercrombys |
| Hawthorn, Kew, Balwyn, inner east | Jellis Craig, Marshall White, RT Edgar |
| Brighton, Hampton and Bayside | Marshall White, Buxton, Jellis Craig, RT Edgar |
| Architectural or historically significant homes | Abercrombys, Marshall White, Kay & Burton |
| Premium apartments and inner-city homes | Belle Property, Jellis Craig, McGrath |
| Broad Melbourne exposure and high auction volume | Jellis Craig, Barry Plant, Buxton, McGrath |

Before appointing an agent, compare **recent comparable sales in the same suburb**, the named auctioneer’s personal results, the quality of the proposed buyer database, and whether the agency will have a senior agent conducting the auction—not merely supervising the campaign.
